capabilities: insert feeling and need words, each with a definition, at the cursor
browse emotion categories or step through them one word at a time
generate four guided NVC notes (make sense, hear them, forgive yourself, thank them)
annotate picked words with personal notes about context and triggers
embed pickers in daily notes or Templater templates via nvc-feelings/nvc-needs fences
extras: The feelings and needs inventory comes from the CNVC Feelings and Needs Inventory; the plugin carries a required attribution credit and code built from it inherits the same obligation. Definitions were written by the plugin author, not CNVC.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in vocabulary or structured prompts for reflecting on emotions and the needs behind them when journaling or working through events.

relations.evidence: The words come from Nonviolent Communication, the practice Marshall Rosenberg developed
a daily note or a Templater template of your own can hold one and have it waiting

summary: NVC-based word picker that inserts feelings and needs with definitions into notes and generates four guided reflection notes.
